name: Nelson Lake East
note: Primitive camping at the east boat ramp, beside the Milton R. Young power station and its substations, so expect plant noise: no numbered sites or pads; rigs park on the open ground at the tip of the small peninsula north-east of the ramp, at the end of a dirt track. No operator publishes rules or a season, so call Oliver County before setting out. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: City of Center 'Parks & RV Parks' page (centernd.net/visit/, read 2026-11-12): 'Nelson Lake offers free primitive campsites' (the whole lake; its address, 2301 35th Ave SW, is the west ramp) -> a town page names the lake's camping (public ladder step 1). Minnkota's Milton R. Young Station brochure (pkmcoop.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/Milton-R.-Young-Station-brochure.pdf, read 2026-11-12): 'Public areas along the lake are used for camping ... Minnkota granted the North Dakota Game and Fish Department an easement ensuring public access to Nelson Lake.' ND Game and Fish Nelson Lake map (gf.nd.gov/gnf/maps/fishing/lakecontours/nelsonoliver2020.pdf, 2020-21, read 2026-11-12): boat ramp, vault toilet and fishing pier at this east-shore access (OSM slipway 47.07516,-101.20582). AllStays 'Nelson Lake East Campground' (allstays.com/Campgrounds-details/41557.htm, read 2026-11-12): primitive, pin 47.074864,-101.205831, phone 701-794-8721 (the Oliver County courthouse, olivercountynd.org) -> listed as its own campground, separate from 'Nelson Lake West' (41558). East-side camping in use: Wayback 2017-05-25 and 2022-09-05 (z18) each show two white camper units ~10 m long parked on open ground at the tip of the small peninsula NE of the ramp (47.0762-47.0763,-101.2030), with tow vehicles; 2016-08-03, 2019-08-06, 2021-08-23 and 2024-10-21 show it empty -> recurring overnight use by RVs, and rigs longer than 23 ft fit. Designated vs allowance: no numbered sites; the camping ground is the open end of the peninsula track, apart from the ramp lot (~150 m away) -> not a parking-lot allowance; padless caveat in the note. Access: from 24th St SW, the paved road past the power plant, a gravel road runs north ~0.8 km from 47.0685,-101.2025 to the ramp and vault toilet, then a dirt track runs ~0.4 km north-east and west onto the peninsula (Esri 2024-10-21 and OSM ways 9741909/9744183/9742070) -> drive-in; no gate mapped or visible; no agency or operator road warning, no 4WD wording anywhere. Operator: no agency page names one; The Dyrt ('managed by Oliver County') and a 2025 Dyrt reviewer ('run by the county') say Oliver County, and AllStays's phone is the county courthouse; the county's own site never mentions Nelson Lake. Not on the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025). No horse facilities or mention; no OHV use. Operating: no camper report says closed or locked; The Dyrt reviews (April 2025, July 2025, October 2026) don't say which side they describe. Duplicate check 2026-11-12: nothing in campgrounds.json within 3 km or named Nelson Lake except the west result (Nelson Lake West, 47.0872,-101.2377, 2.9 km, own access off 35th Ave SW); not on RV Life (Algolia 10 km query 2026-11-12).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Wayback 2022-09-05 and 2017-05-25 (z18 at 47.0758,-101.2025), 2016-08-03, 2019-08-06, 2021-08-23 and Esri 2024-10-21 (z17/z18). The peninsula is a ~120 m tongue of open grass and bare ground in Nelson Lake's north-east arm, with a brush rim only along part of its north side; the camping ground at its west tip is ~5-20 m from the water on three sides over open ground. In both 2017 and 2022 the two camper units sit within ~10-15 m of the water with nothing between -> RVs on the water, lakefront. Dam check: the lake's earthen dam on Square Butte Creek lies at the south end by the power station, ~1 km south of the peninsula (G&F water-control symbol); the peninsula is on the lake side, in the reservoir itself; G&F full pool 1,926.7 ft (587.3 m), Open-Meteo DEM 586 m at the pin and 586 m on open water -> at pool level, not below a berm. The dike east of the peninsula separates the lake from a plant pond; the camping faces the lake, not the pond.

sites.note: No numbered sites or pads: open ground at the peninsula tip.

sites_source: Wayback 2017-05-25 and 2022-09-05 imagery (two campers on open ground at the peninsula tip; no pads or site posts), Esri 2024-10-21; AllStays 41557 (primitive, no site count), read 2026-11-12
facilities_source: https://gf.nd.gov/gnf/maps/fishing/lakecontours/nelsonoliver2020.pdf (ND Game and Fish map 2020-21: vault toilet at the east boat ramp, ~150 m from the peninsula), read 2026-11-12; small building at the ramp on Esri 2024-10-21

booking.note: No reservations; free, first come first served.

booking_source: https://centernd.net/visit/#rv (free primitive campsites, no booking channel or contact given), read 2026-11-12
flags: Split from lead 16 at the coordinator's direction (2026-11-12). This area stands on thinner, area-specific evidence than the west: the AllStays 'Nelson Lake East' listing, Game and Fish's ramp/toilet map, and campers on imagery in 2017 and 2022. The city page, the Minnkota brochure and The Dyrt cover the lake as a whole. Kept under the free-primitive low bar (no closed/locked report).

Ownership/phone as in the west result: Minnkota land with a G&F access easement. Stored local (Oliver County) on The Dyrt's and a reviewer's word; the phone is the county courthouse. The alternative is private (utility), if AWH reads it as Minnkota's.
Setting: next to the power plant's substations and transmission lines (Esri 2024), so plant noise is likely.

Pin is the peninsula tip where the campers stood (47.0763,-101.2031), not the ramp. Whether the grass along the ramp loop's west-shore road is also used for camping is not shown on any capture. That shore has a rocky (possibly riprap) edge, so the peninsula alone carries the lakefront call.
Roadtrippers (a 'Nelson Lake Dispersed Camping' page that may describe this side) refused the fetch and was not used.
curation_note: ND lead 16 east (2026-11-12): split from Nelson Lake West (2.9 km; own access off 24th St SW past the Young Station). Camping ground = the small peninsula NE of the east ramp, campers on imagery 2017-05-25 and 2022-09-05. AllStays lists it as 'Nelson Lake East Campground'. Operator as for the west (Oliver County per The Dyrt; county courthouse phone; Minnkota land). --Claude
